tasks.subject: Task 1: Rebase onto current upstream main
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: `README.md` (conflict resolution only)
- Modify: `config.json` (conflict resolution only)
- Modify: `.gitignore` (conflict resolution only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] An `upstream` remote pointing at aehrc/redcap_fhir_ontology_provider exists
- [ ] Branch contains every commit from `upstream/main` (composer.json, psalm.xml, stubs/, CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] No conflict markers remain in any file
- [ ] config.json still declares framework-version 1, php-version-min 5.4.0, redcap-version-min 8.8.1
- [ ] `php -l` clean on both PHP files and config.json parses
- [ ] Psalm runs and its findings are recorded as the pre-change baseline

**Verify:** `php -l FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php && php -l FindValueSetService.php && python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('config.json'))" && git log --oneline -1 upstream/main` -> all clean, no conflict markers

tasks.subject: Task 2: Test harness and request policy class
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create this branch's first automated verification - a dependency-free PHP test runner - and extract the timeout and circuit-breaker decisions into pure, testable functions.

**Files:**
- Create: `FhirRequestPolicy.php`
- Create: `tests/run.php`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Runner provides assertSame, assertTrue, assertFalse and records pass/fail
- [ ] Runner exits 0 on pass, 1 on fail, and prints a summary line
- [ ] resolveTimeout() returns the setting when numeric and positive; default for blank, zero, negative, non-numeric
- [ ] countsAsFailure() true at and above 80% of timeout, false below
- [ ] isOpen() false when openUntil is 0, true inside window, false at or after expiry
- [ ] needsRearm() true only when a non-zero window has elapsed
- [ ] opensBreaker() true at and above threshold
- [ ] No composer, no PHPUnit, no external dependency introduced
- [ ] No `??`, no `::class`, no `fn()`

**Verify:** `php -l FhirRequestPolicy.php && php tests/run.php` -> `OK (26 assertions)`, exit code 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["FhirRequestPolicy.php", "tests/run.php"], "verifyCommand": "php -l FhirRequestPolicy.php && php tests/run.php", "acceptanceCriteria": ["runner exits 0 on pass and 1 on fail", "timeout and breaker decisions are pure functions", "no composer or PHPUnit introduced", "no PHP 7+ constructs"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Delegate breaker and correct false claim
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the circuit breaker's inline decisions with calls into FhirRequestPolicy, and rewrite the docblock that asserts a concurrency guarantee the code does not provide.

**Files:**
- Modify: `FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php` (constants ~line 34; getFhirTimeout ~861; isCircuitOpen ~876; recordFhirFailure ~892; recordFhirFailureIfSlow ~906)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The four methods contain no inline arithmetic or comparisons - every decision is a FhirRequestPolicy:: call
- [ ] Settings reads and writes stay in the module; the policy class performs no I/O
- [ ] isCircuitOpen() docblock no longer claims "exactly one concurrent request is allowed through"
- [ ] Replacement docblock states concurrent callers may each admit a probe and concurrent failures may undercount
- [ ] External behaviour unchanged - same thresholds, window, and 80% rule
- [ ] The module require_once's FhirRequestPolicy.php
- [ ] Duplicated constants removed from the module class with no stale references
- [ ] `php -l` clean; tests still exit 0

**Verify:** `php -l FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php && php tests/run.php && grep -c 'exactly one' FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php` -> no syntax errors, `OK (26 assertions)`, grep count 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php"], "verifyCommand": "php -l FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php && php tests/run.php", "acceptanceCriteria": ["false atomicity claim removed", "decisions delegated to FhirRequestPolicy", "external behaviour unchanged", "no stale constant references"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: URL containment check
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a pure function deciding whether a request URL stays within the configured FHIR base, so the module-owned curl in Task 7 has a real SSRF defence rather than a taint suppression.

**Files:**
- Modify: `FhirRequestPolicy.php`
- Modify: `tests/run.php`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A URL under the configured base is accepted
- [ ] A different host is rejected
- [ ] A scheme change (https base, http request) is rejected
- [ ] A different port is rejected, including an explicit port differing from the base's implicit default
- [ ] A URL carrying embedded credentials (user:pass@) is rejected
- [ ] A path outside the base path is rejected, including the sibling-prefix case (/fhirX against base /fhir)
- [ ] Non-string, empty and unparseable input is rejected
- [ ] Tests exit 0

**Verify:** `php -l FhirRequestPolicy.php && php tests/run.php` -> `OK (40 assertions)`, exit code 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["FhirRequestPolicy.php", "tests/run.php"], "verifyCommand": "php -l FhirRequestPolicy.php && php tests/run.php", "acceptanceCriteria": ["different host rejected", "scheme downgrade rejected", "sibling prefix /fhirX rejected against /fhir", "embedded credentials rejected"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7a: wire SSRF guard + narrow timeout claim (curl rewrite deferred)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Give outbound FHIR requests a real end-to-end timeout by issuing curl from the module instead of delegating to REDCap core, which sets only CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT. BLOCKED: do not begin until the maintainer answers the TLS question on PR #5. If unanswered, STOP and ask the user whether to wait or ship Tasks 1-6 with the timeout claim narrowed. Do not guess the TLS setting.

**Files:**
- Modify: `FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php` (httpGet ~923, httpPost ~959)
- Modify: `README.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The maintainer's TLS answer is recorded in the commit message and the SSL_VERIFYPEER/VERIFYHOST values match it
- [ ] A single private fhirRequest() performs every outbound request; httpGet and httpPost are thin wrappers
- [ ] Both CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT and CURLOPT_TIMEOUT are set from getFhirTimeout()
- [ ] CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION is false so a redirect cannot escape the containment check
- [ ] Every request is checked with isWithinBase() against getFhirServerUri(), except the OAuth2 token endpoint which matches its own setting
- [ ] A request failing containment returns false without dialling out
- [ ] Proxy support mirrors the existing fallback (sameHostUrl, PROXY_HOSTNAME, PROXY_USERNAME_PASSWORD)
- [ ] The file_get_contents fallback is retained unchanged as streamRequest()
- [ ] The Content-type header workaround in the old httpPost is removed
- [ ] curl_close() runs on every path including failure
- [ ] Psalm reports no new TaintedSSRF relative to the Task 1 baseline
- [ ] README timeout paragraph updated to describe a true end-to-end bound
- [ ] `php -l` clean; tests exit 0

**Verify:** `php -l FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php && php tests/run.php && vendor/bin/psalm --taint-analysis --no-progress` -> no syntax errors, `OK (40 assertions)`, no new TaintedSSRF versus baseline

```json:metadata
{"files": ["FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "php -l FhirOntologyAutocompleteExternalModule.php && php tests/run.php && vendor/bin/psalm --taint-analysis --no-progress", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CURLOPT_TIMEOUT set from getFhirTimeout()", "core http_get/http_post no longer called", "every request constrained by isWithinBase()", "no new TaintedSSRF versus baseline", "TLS values match the maintainer's answer"], "modelTier": "frontier", "blockedOnExternalInput": true}
```
